items.question: What team does Leonie Fiebich play for?
items.answer: Leonie Fiebich plays forward for the New York Liberty. She won the 2024 WNBA championship with New York in her first WNBA season.

items.question: Where is Leonie Fiebich from?
items.answer: Leonie Fiebich is from Germany. She played for Germany at the 2024 Olympics and was twice named MVP of Spain's top women's league, in 2023 and 2024.

items.question: When was Leonie Fiebich drafted?
items.answer: The Los Angeles Sparks selected Leonie Fiebich in the second round, 22nd overall, of the 2020 WNBA Draft. Los Angeles traded her rights to the Chicago Sky in 2021, and she made her WNBA debut with the New York Liberty in 2024.

items.question: Was Leonie Fiebich a rookie in 2024?
items.answer: Yes. Leonie Fiebich was a WNBA rookie in 2024, when she made the All-Rookie Team and won the title with New York. Her 43.3% three-point shooting that season ranks second all-time among WNBA rookies.
